name: Cherry Studio
description: Runs a Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop client for OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Ollama, and LM Studio models, with 300+ preset assistants and MCP server support.

skills.name: Multi-Provider Chat
skills.description: Routes conversations to OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Perplexity, Poe, or local Ollama and LM Studio models from one client.

skills.name: Preset Assistants
skills.description: Applies any of 300+ pre-configured AI assistants or custom ones, and queries several models simultaneously in one conversation.

skills.name: MCP Server Integration
skills.description: Connects Model Context Protocol servers to the desktop client so conversations can call external tools and data sources.

skills.name: Document Processing
skills.description: Ingests text, image, Office, and PDF files for chat, and backs the library up over WebDAV for cross-device access.

skills.name: Team Knowledge Base
skills.description: Builds and shares team-wide knowledge bases with role-based access control over models and features via an admin backend.
